choices.why: Cream three-seat sofa at 221 cm, a good fit for the middle of the long left wall, with the soft textile look the warm Nordic style calls for.
Cream high-back wing chair, comfortable for reading, with nailhead trim that matches the sofa.
Light ash table with angled legs, a clear Nordic piece that brings in the light wood the user asked for.
The only rug large enough (292x231) to sit under the sofa, armchair and coffee table, in a calm beige-gray gradient.
Light wood table with a herringbone top, 180 cm long so it seats six comfortably, in a Nordic style.
Light beech chairs with woven paper-cord seats, a classic Scandinavian design that suits the light table.
Light bamboo sphere pendant that adds natural warmth above the dining table.
Linen-shade floor lamp with warm light, ideal beside the reading chair and in the same cream tones.
White sideboard with light wood herringbone fronts that echoes the dining table top.
Light white sheer curtains that filter the window light without blocking it.
Green linen cushions that bring the touch of green the user asked for against the cream sofa and armchair.
Taupe knit throw with fringe that adds warmth and texture on the cream sofa.
Tall leafy areca palm that adds a strong green note to the corner between living and dining areas.
Large 122x91 landscape in gray and copper tones, well proportioned above the sofa and warm in color.
Ceramic vase in soft cream-green with a leaf relief, in keeping with the natural palette.

answer.why: Cream textiles, light woods with herringbone patterns, natural fibers like papercord and bamboo, and touches of green from plants and cushions create a warm, cohesive Nordic living-dining room that sits well with the white walls and oak floor.
